coverage: real-pool callback bookkeeping and stable logical identity
atomic scheduler and GGUF high-water admission
engine-loop config propagation from public LLM
c1 and packed graph pin/unpin hooks

implementation.allocation_layout: one contiguous backing chunk per request; per-layer K/V subviews

known_non_claims: D3 does not add a throughput, TTFT, ITL, or native-width performance claim.
D4 still owns OpenAI streaming delivery, per-row backpressure, disconnect integration, and shutdown drain.
Dynamic request-sized GGUF allocation is admitted for BF16 KV only; INT8 and mixed KV retain their existing non-D3 paths.
gfx1151 E1 remains hardware-blocked and no gfx1151 result is inferred from W7900.
Native c8 remains unimplemented; chunked c8 is not a native-c8 claim.
Sampled HIP used bytes are allocator-granular and do not contract byte-for-byte with tracked page frees; pool and tracked counters are the exact ownership oracle.
next_gate: D4 OpenAI API streaming/backpressure/cancellation/drain through the same model-owning loop.

allocator_and_hip_memory_audit.evidence: Tracked grow and shrink are each exactly 15,728,640 bytes; 12-page burst tracked high water is 25,172,815,456 bytes and pool high water is 62,914,560 bytes. Sampled HIP current/peak are retained separately and show allocator granularity rather than being treated as an exact page oracle.

atomic_high_water.evidence: A real-HIP 3-page cap rejects request 3002 with the head row unleased/unallocated and leaves current/refcounted pages exactly 3/3; host scheduler tests retain pending identity and publish no slot.

barrier_growth_and_safe_shrink.evidence: Clean real-HIP lifecycle transitions 3->6->3->12->3 pages; only fully free unpinned tail chunks shrink.

burst_steady_idle_burst_pointer_graph_va.evidence: Live low-water and tail representative pointers remain unchanged through grow/replay/shrink; a real graph pins three pages, replays exact token/state/KV, is invalidated once before reclaim, and regrowth uses fresh logical ids 6-14.

d2_lifecycle_non_regression.evidence: The clean A/B/C/D live gate remains token/Conv/GDN/live-KV exact; B and C reuse ids 3-5/backing/session, D regrows ids 6-8, and final pool state is three free pages.

real_paged_admission.evidence: Clean p512 requests bind three real 5,242,880-byte BF16 pages before scheduler slot publication and execute prefill/decode through those subviews.
